summary: Being yourself and the urge to disrupt grind against each other in you. You need to be free, and you provoke reactions, sometimes without meaning to. Restlessness sits right under the surface.
body: Being yourself and the urge to disrupt grind against each other in you. You need to be free, and you provoke reactions, sometimes without meaning to. Restlessness sits right under the surface. You may rebel against anything that boxes you in, or feel boxed in even when nothing's holding you. That friction is the engine you run on; it pushes you to build a life on your own terms. The work is choosing what to disrupt instead of disrupting on reflex. Pointed well, you change things that needed changing.
gift: At your best: a genuine original who refuses to live by default.
shadow: The trap: disrupting on reflex, or feeling caged when nothing's holding you.
integration: Let identity and freedom and disruption cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Suited to independent or innovative work where you aren't boxed in.
do: Choose what to disrupt on purpose
Build the life on your own terms
Channel the restlessness into change that matters
dont: Blow things up to feel free
Mistake every limit for a cage
